pack.linkedin:
We need to talk about what your cash is actually doing in the background.

Recent data shows inflation in Portugal sitting at 3.9%, while new term deposits are averaging around 1.83%. Put simply, if your savings sit in a standard account, their purchasing power is quietly shrinking.

It is easy to assume that leaving money untouched is the safest option. But in a changing economic climate, safety has a hidden cost. Understanding how inflation interacts with your interest rates is one of the most practical steps you can take for your personal finances.

Take five minutes today to check the actual return on your savings. Knowledge is your best defence.

#PersonalFinance #Savings #PaperMint

faq.q: What is the current inflation rate in Portugal?
faq.a: Eurostat data for October 2026 puts annual inflation in Portugal at 3.9%. The twelve-month average sits at 2.9%.

faq.q: How do term deposit rates compare to inflation?
faq.a: Data for September 2026 shows new term deposits in Portugal averaging 1.83%. This sits below the current inflation rate.

faq.q: What is the current ECB deposit rate?
faq.a: The European Central Bank deposit rate has remained at 2.5% since September 2026.
The 12-month Euribor averaged 3.239% in October 2026. This rate often influences variable mortgage pricing.

faq.q: What was the average new mortgage rate in Portugal?
faq.a: Data from September 2026 shows the average new mortgage rate in Portugal was 3.06%.
